items.title: 12 to 16 week transformation
items.text: A complete program with a fixed start and finish: training, nutrition and weekly check-ins, built to take you from where you are to a clear goal in 12 to 16 weeks.

items.title: 1:1 personal training
items.text: Private sessions focused on technique, progressive overload and getting the most out of every set. Ideal if you want hands-on coaching.

items.title: Online coaching
items.text: A custom training and nutrition plan in your phone, weekly check-ins, form reviews on video and direct WhatsApp access.

items.title: Physique & contest prep
items.text: Cutting phases, peak week, posing practice and stage-day planning for bodybuilding and physique competitors.

items.title: Nutrition guidance
items.text: Calorie and macro targets built around foods you already enjoy, so fat loss or muscle gain fits your real life.
